info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Wholesale Trading Trading Book Oversight-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Book Oversight API enables financial institutions to manage and oversee their wholesale trading activities effectively. This API allows users to create and maintain trading books, ensuring compliance and risk management in trading operations. Typical consumers include trading desks and compliance teams seeking real-time oversight and reporting capabilities. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their trading strategies while maintaining regulatory standards and transparency.

post.description: This operation allows users to create a new trading book oversight, facilitating better management and regulatory compliance of trading activities.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary data for managing oversight of the trading book in wholesale trading operations. It includes specific parameters that detail the operations to be performed and the context of the trading activity.
